title: Orchid Confluence
description: The batch closes with a meeting of its three worlds: a private bass conversation, an increasingly free solo, and a four-voice ensemble. Their agreement opens into fuller chords before a final cadenza. The returning minor theme gradually acquires a major third, ending with a warm sixth and ninth.
technical_note: Plan the large arc across the solo, quartet and chordal sections. Keep each of the four central voices independent, and practise the two cadenza bars without pedal before adding their late bass replies. Let the major-third change near the end sound like a gradual clearing.

performance.note: Authored breathing, changing dialogue and independent voicing; no random timing.

composition_time_source: Recorded when the first score was saved.

audio_reverb.description: Subtle warm room; preserve the clarity of moving voices.
